title: Domain use-mobile copies: migrate callers to canonical contract
goal: Per owner Design Q1-C direction, migrate remaining callers of hooks/venue/use-mobile.tsx and app/admin/dashboard/components/hooks/use-mobile.tsx toward the canonical object-returning hooks/use-mobile.ts, preserving intentional responsive-hook differences and converting leftover copies to re-exports only where an owning surface has an explicit migration constraint.

out: Consumer files (all six already consume canonical; none modified)
venue/admin behavior changes (owning surfaces decide final shim removal)
OTHER-5 mobile app / react-native surfaces (no importers existed)

acceptance_criteria: Consumer audit: every live importer of any use-mobile source resolves to the canonical hooks/use-mobile.ts object contract; no boolean-only consumer remains.

Domain copies are not deleted: hooks/venue/use-mobile.tsx and app/admin/dashboard/components/hooks/use-mobile.tsx are converted to pure compatibility re-exports of the canonical hook, preserving their import paths for any owning-surface constraint.
Register reflects the conversion: row 36 (admin copy) canonical target corrected to hooks/use-mobile.ts; stale components/ui/use-mobile.tsx keep row corrected to retired (file deleted in DESIGN-002).

Focused verification passes: same-identity contract test, zero-use rg sweep, eslint on changed files, scoped TypeScript on changed files, git diff --check on changed paths, npm run agents:validate with 0 warnings 0 errors.

commands: rg -n "use-mobile" app components hooks lib apps __tests__ scripts --glob "*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}"
evidence: Consumer audit PASSED (2026-09-11): all six live consumers of use-mobile import the canonical hooks/use-mobile.ts with the object contract — hooks/use-mobile-performance.ts, components/ui/sidebar.tsx, components/mobile/mobile-optimized-card.tsx, components/mobile/unified-mobile-navigation.tsx, components/mobile/enhanced-mobile-navigation.tsx, components/mobile/mobile-navigation-audit.tsx. No consumer imports either domain copy, so no caller migration was needed.

Zero-consumer validation for both domain copies PASSED: bounded rg sweeps for 'hooks/venue/use-mobile' and 'app/admin/dashboard/components/hooks/use-mobile' across app components hooks lib apps __tests__ scripts (glob *.ts,tsx,js,jsx) returned 0 importer matches each; no barrel files exist at hooks/ or app/admin/dashboard/components/hooks (rg for index/barrel patterns returned none); no tsconfig path alias targets either copy path.

Copies verified byte-identical boolean-only contracts before conversion (diff(1) IDENTICAL: both returned !!isMobile with 768 breakpoint, no named exports besides useIsMobile); DESIGN-027 documented this boolean-only contract as the intentional surface difference (category b).

Post-conversion rg sweep PASSED: every use-mobile reference is either the canonical hooks/use-mobile.ts, its consumers, the two re-export shims, or the new contract test; no boolean-only implementation remains anywhere in the source tree. Exit 0.

Contract test PASSED (2026-09-11): npx vitest run __tests__/design-system/use-mobile-contract.test.ts __tests__/design-system/shared-state-primitives.test.tsx -> 2 files, 5 tests passed. use-mobile-contract.test.ts asserts venueUseIsMobile === canonicalUseIsMobile and adminUseIsMobile === canonicalUseIsMobile (same function object = zero behavioral fork) and full export surface (useTouchDevice, useHapticFeedback) is preserved.

Scoped TypeScript PASSED: temp tsconfig extending root tsconfig.json (preserving @/* paths) over the three changed files -> tsc --noEmit exit 0, no diagnostics. (Bare-file tsc invocation is not valid: it ignores tsconfig paths and fails on @/ and vitest internals; the temp-project approach is the correct scoped check.)

git diff --check PASSED for all DESIGN-031 changed paths (hooks/venue/use-mobile.tsx, app/admin/dashboard/components/hooks/use-mobile.tsx, __tests__/design-system/use-mobile-contract.test.ts, CANONICAL_COMPONENT_REGISTER.csv). Pre-existing trailing-whitespace findings in app/admin/dashboard/venues/page.tsx and app/venue/staff/roles-permissions/page.tsx are unrelated dirty-worktree lanes, untouched by this task.

CSV integrity PASSED (post-edit): python csv parse -> 1339 data rows + header, every row exactly 9 columns, 0 malformed rows; register prefixes remain only app/ and components/ (hooks/venue path is documented in STATE.md, not register-tracked, matching register convention).

npm run agents:validate PASSED twice (baseline before edits and after): validated 17 agents, 96 tasks, 0 warnings, 0 errors. (Task prompt expected 95 tasks; the control plane reports 96 — actual count used.)

progress.summary: Domain use-mobile copies reconciled under owner Q1-C: audit found all 6 live consumers already on the canonical object-returning hooks/use-mobile.ts; both domain copies (hooks/venue/use-mobile.tsx and app/admin/dashboard/components/hooks/use-mobile.tsx) were ZERO-consumer and converted to pure re-exports of the canonical hook (admin copy uses relative import to avoid its subtree alias cycle). Added use-mobile-contract.test.ts asserting same-function identity; register row 36 retargeted to hooks/use-mobile.ts. Shim-removal decisions handed off to venue/admin owner surfaces.
completed: Audited every consumer of all three use-mobile sources; all six live consumers use canonical hooks/use-mobile.ts (no caller migration required).
Re-validated both domain copies as zero-consumer (bounded rg per path; no barrels; no tsconfig aliases) and confirmed byte-identical boolean-only implementations.

Ran and recorded the full verification suite (consumer audit, zero-use sweeps, contract test, eslint, scoped tsc, diff check, CSV parse, agents:validate).
